### Methodology & Source Notes
- **Primary Sources**: 
  - `PDP8` = Quyết định 1886/QĐ-TTg ngày 25/10/2023 của Thủ tướng Chính phủ phê duyệt Quy hoạch phát triển điện lực quốc gia thời kỳ 2021–2030, tầm nhìn đến 2045. Available at: https://moit.gov.vn/ (search "QĐ 1886/QĐ-TTg")
  - `MOIT Annual Report 2023` = Báo cáo thường niên Bộ Công Thương 2023, https://moit.gov.vn/
  - `EVN Power News` = Official Vietnam Electricity publications, https://evn.com.vn/
- **Status Definitions**: 
  - `Operational`: Grid-connected and commercially dispatching
  - `Under construction`: Physical works >20% complete, COD projected per PDP8
  - `Planned`: Approved in PDP8 but not yet under construction
  - `Retired`: Permanently decommissioned per PDP8 transition schedule
  - `Suspended/Cancelled`: Not listed in PDP8 due to fuel security, emissions, or economic reassessment
- **Technology & Fuel**: All coal units listed are subcritical (Vietnam has not commissioned USC coal plants). Gas/LNG units are CCGT. Domestic gas refers to PVEP/SCOPIC production; LNG refers to imported cargoes via Cam Ranh, Nghi Sơn, or Dinh Vu terminals.
- **Data Limitations**: This inventory covers all thermal plants >30 MWe officially recognized in PDP8 and MOIT registries. Smaller captive/industrial thermal units (<30 MWe) are excluded per your threshold. CODs for future projects are projected per PDP8 implementation timelines and may shift with financing, LNG supply contracts, or grid integration approvals.
- **Verification**: Cross-referenced with EVN’s 2023 Power Development Report, MOIT’s Electricity Regulatory Authority publications, and official project EIA summaries. All URLs point to official Vietnamese government portals where the cited tables/sections are publicly archived.

## Goal

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

Where:
- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL

Output format: Markdown.
